description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Diana''' unleashes a bolt of lunar energy that travels in a counter-clockwise arc before exploding at the target location, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 0.5 seconds and dealing magic damage to enemies hit and afflicting them with ''Moonlight'' for 3 seconds, during which they are [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]].
description.text: Active: Diana unleashes a bolt of lunar energy that travels in a counter-clockwise arc before exploding at the target location, granting sight of the area for 0.5 seconds and dealing magic damage to enemies hit and afflicting them with Moonlight for 3 seconds, during which they are revealed.

description2.raw: ''[[File:Diana Lunar Rush.png|20xpx|border|link=Diana#Lunar Rush|An icon for Diana's ability Lunar Rush]] [[Diana#Lunar Rush|Lunar Rush]]'' interacts with ''Moonlight''.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 (+ 70% AP)

notes.raw: * Even if the target [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shields]] the bolt, they may still be damaged by the explosion. ''Moonlight'' is not applied to the protected target if blocked. * The bolt consists of two [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectiles]] with slightly different trajectories. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
